questions.answer: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is a strategic framework for making sure your brand appears in AI-generated search results and recommendations. It involves optimizing your digital footprint so AI systems like ChatGPT, Google's AI features and Perplexity recognize your brand as authoritative, relevant and trustworthy enough to cite [6]. It is broader and longer term than AEO, focusing on making a brand a recognized entity that AI systems mention by name [5]. Joe's site also notes that GEO depends on solid technical SEO foundations, since AI search engines discover content through the same basic mechanisms as traditional crawlers [8].

questions.answer: Based on this site's FAQ, SEO is a long-term investment, and timelines depend on your starting point, competition, and goals. Technical fixes and quick wins can show impact within weeks, meaningful organic traffic growth typically appears between three and six months, and substantial, compounding results are often visible at six to twelve months [1]. questions.answer: An MCP server connects an AI application such as Claude to outside tools and data. It can let Claude read from a database, query an analytics account, or take an action in another system [1]. The Model Context Protocol is an open standard for this. With an MCP server, Claude can read your CRM or reporting data within limits you set, usually read-only to start [2]. Joe builds mostly with Claude and MCP [3]. To discuss a setup, you can use the [contact page](/contact/).
